IOT.source: No permanent population: only military and contract staff

Australian Indian Ocean Territories.source: Christmas Island (135 km², 1,692 people) plus the Cocos (Keeling) Islands (14 km², 593 people); Australian census 2021

Ashmore and Cartier Islands.source: CIA World Factbook area; no permanent population

Siachen Glacier.source: Area measured from the Natural Earth outline on the map; no permanent population, only soldiers

Somaliland.source: Somaliland government: claimed area, and its Ministry of Planning projection from the 2014 PESS survey. Estimates range from about 4.5 to 6.2 million

North Cyprus.source: Northern Cyprus Statistics Institute projection for the end of 2023 (last census 2011); other estimates are far higher
